housing-numbers.notes: Total requirement of 42,100 homes for 2013-2030 period. Committed housing includes 9,627 units with planning permission plus 4,935 unimplemented RUDP allocations. Document is a Core Strategy that sets overall requirements - specific allocations to be determined in subsequent Allocations DPD.
